objects.name: HPE security advisory (AV26-571)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-571 Date: June 9, 2026 On June 9, 2026, HPE published a security advisory to address vulnerabilities in the following products: HPE Aruba Networking Management Software (Airwave) – version 8.3.0.6 and prior HPE Aruba Networking Private 5G Management Dashboard – all versions The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply the necessary updates. HPESBNW05064 rev.1 - Status of NGINX ngx_http_rewrite_module Vulnerability (CVE-2026-42945) in HPE Aruba Networking Products HPE Security Bulletin Library
